commands.name: list-directory-categories
commands.summary: List the directory's industry and location categories with their URL slugs, plus links to hiring-by-location pages

commands.name: get-company
commands.summary: Get a YC company's profile page by slug (title/tagline and summary description with founders, team size, location, hiring)

commands.name: list-company-jobs
commands.summary: List the open job postings of a YC company

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get a job posting (title, description, salary range, location, remote type, date posted) from its structured JobPosting data

commands.name: get-launch
commands.summary: Get a Launch YC post: title, tagline, upvote count, author, company link and posting date

commands.name: list-jobs
commands.summary: List featured jobs at YC startups from the Work at a Startup jobs board

commands.name: list-jobs-by-role
commands.summary: List jobs at YC startups for one role (e.g. product-manager, software-engineer)

commands.name: list-jobs-by-role-location
commands.summary: List jobs at YC startups for one role in a given location or remote

commands.name: list-people
commands.summary: List YC people (president, partners, staff) with short bios and profile links

commands.name: get-person
commands.summary: Get a YC person's profile (name, role, bio) by slug

dropped.name: search-companies
dropped.reason: Algolia rejects the request with 'Invalid Application-ID or API key'. The embedded API key is truncated or rotated. The full secured key lives in a JS variable on /companies, which selector-based CSRF extraction can't read reliably. No working replay without it.

dropped.name: list-company-facets
dropped.reason: Uses the same invalid Algolia API key as search-companies (403 'Invalid Application-ID or API key'). Can't be replayed without a valid key.
